stages.label: Approved by council (zoning or subdivision)
stages.source: Planning Applications Active (City of Kitchener), City of Kitchener, https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=b7e2f8feda7340eaa5f4dd7b9c4d5ac0, retrieved 2026-11-14, Open Government Licence – City of Kitchener (licence text on the item page): applications on the city's active list that are zoning by-law amendments passed by council or subdivisions draft-approved, and whose description is about homes, with a council meeting or draft approval date 2022-01-01 to 2026-08-24 (first in window: 2022-06-20). Unit counts are not given: the list's unit fields are empty.

stages.label: Site plan approved
stages.source: Application Status Report Site Plan (City of Kitchener), City of Kitchener, https://app2.kitchener.ca/appdocs/opendata/AMANDADataSets/Application_Status_Site_Plan.csv, retrieved 2026-11-14, Open Government Licence – City of Kitchener (licence text on the item page): site plan applications received 2022-01-01 to 2026-11-05 whose status is Approved, Conditional Approval, Ready for Final Approval or Pre-Permit (not yet 'Construction') and whose description is about homes. The file gives no unit counts.

stages.label: Building permit issued
stages.source: Building Permits (City of Kitchener), City of Kitchener, https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=c486d37abe2948d884a159cba20bec8c, retrieved 2026-11-14, Open Government Licence – City of Kitchener (licence text on the item page): new units on residential permits issued 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-29 (cancelled or revoked permits left out).

stages.label: Under construction
stages.source: Building Permits (City of Kitchener), City of Kitchener, https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=c486d37abe2948d884a159cba20bec8c, retrieved 2026-11-14, Open Government Licence – City of Kitchener (licence text on the item page): permits issued 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-29 that are still open. Status Issued, Ready to Final or Violation, with no occupancy date.

stages.label: Completed
stages.source: Building Permits (City of Kitchener), City of Kitchener, https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=c486d37abe2948d884a159cba20bec8c, retrieved 2026-11-14, Open Government Licence – City of Kitchener (licence text on the item page): new units on permits whose occupancy was permitted or final inspection passed in the window (2022-01-01 to 2026-10-29). Date used: occupancy permitted, or the final inspection date if there is no occupancy date.

timeBetween.note: Not measurable from public data: planning approvals and building permits are published in separate lists with no shared file number, so the same project can't be followed from approval to permit.
Median days from permit application to permit issued, over 4,742 residential permits issued 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-29. For permits with 10 or more new units: 172 days (135 permits).

Median days from permit issued to final inspection or occupancy, over 5,505 residential permits finished 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-29 (the same permit followed across both dates). For permits with 10 or more new units: 892 days (140 permits). Only finished permits count, so slow projects still under way are not in it yet; most permits are single homes and basement units, which finish fastest.

target.label: Ontario's housing target for Kitchener: 35,000 new homes from 2022 to 2031. The province counts 9,594 homes toward it from 2022 through 2024. In 2024: 3,067 against a 2024 target of 2,917 (Exceeded). Source: "Ontario’s housing supply: January – December 2024", https://data.ontario.ca/dataset/ontario-s-housing-supply-progress (Open Government Licence – Ontario).

progress.source: Ontario's housing supply progress, "Ontario’s housing supply: January – December 2024", column "Total housing progress since 2022"; Government of Ontario, Open Government Licence – Ontario. This is the province's own count toward the target, not permits or CMHC completions.

hardToTrack: Approved but no building permit yet: no city publishes a list that links a council approval (zoning, subdivision or site plan) to the building permits that follow, so nobody outside city hall can count the homes waiting between approval and permit.

Construction start: permits show the day a permit was issued, not the day work began. Here 'under construction' means a permit issued since 2022 with no final inspection or occupancy yet; some of those may not have started, and some may have lapsed.

Units in permits vs units built: a permit's unit count is what was proposed. The cities don't publish how many units were finally built, so completed units here are the permit's units on permits marked finished.
One building, several permits: big projects can be split into phases or permits (and townhouse blocks into one permit per unit), so 'projects' counts permits, not buildings.
Who the homes are for: permits don't say whether units are rentals, condos or affordable homes.
Finish dates: a permit's final inspection or closing date can come months or years after people moved in, so permits 'completed' in a period are not the same as CMHC's completions for that period.

Units at approval: Kitchener's planning applications list has fields for residential units, but they are empty for all 213 applications, and the site plan status file has no unit field, so approved units can only be read from staff reports one by one.
Starts and completions by city: CMHC counts housing starts and completions for the whole Kitchener-Cambridge-Waterloo area (including Woolwich and North Dumfries), not for each city.

Progress toward the 2031 target: the province counts its own figure for Kitchener (the target's progress here, through the end of its latest published year). It is not the same measure as completed permits, so the completed stage above should not be read against the target.
